text.label: Text: Who We Are
text.value: Who We Are

text.label: Heading: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Here is what t
text.value: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Here is what that means.

text.label: Text: The short answer.
text.value: The short answer.

text.label: Text: You are very good at something. People are watching. And the
text.value: You are very good at something. People are watching. And the money does not match either one. That is the person my team and I work for. So when somebody asks what Steven James Consulting does, this is the answer. We are a modern day talent agency. A talent agent has always had one job. Find somebody who is very good at something, get them in front of the people who need them, and make sure they get paid for it. We do that job for coaches, authors, speakers and influencers. You are the talent. We are the people behind you.

text.label: Text: What that looks like.
text.value: What that looks like.

text.label: Text: In practice it comes down to three things. We teach you self
text.value: In practice it comes down to three things. We teach you self-promotion, which is simply letting people know you exist and what you can do for them. We take what you know and package it into something a person can buy. And we build the website and the sales system that sells it for you, day and night. You stay the expert. We build everything that carries your knowledge to the person who will pay for it.

text.label: Text: Forty years.
text.value: Forty years.

text.label: Text: I opened my first business, a restaurant, in 1986. After tha
text.value: I opened my first business, a restaurant, in 1986. After that came mortgage, roofing, trucking and now technology. That is five businesses over forty years, and in every one of them I was the person who built the systems. The work was different each time. The lesson never changed. The business people knew about, with a system behind it to catch them, beat the business that was simply good at the work. Being good was only the starting line. That is as true for a coach with a following as it was for a restaurant on a corner.

text.label: Text: My team and I.
text.value: My team and I.

text.label: Text: Steven James Consulting is a US company with a team behind t
text.value: Steven James Consulting is a US company with a team behind the work. They build the websites, produce the shows, put the books together and keep the AI employees tuned. I am personally on your account. You get both. A team that does the building, and somebody across the table who has run his own businesses through good years and slow ones and had to work out where the next customer was coming from.

text.label: Text: We run on it ourselves.
text.value: We run on it ourselves.

text.label: Text: Everything we build for a client, we built for ourselves fir
text.value: Everything we build for a client, we built for ourselves first. This website is the same kind of website. My book, Attention To Dollars, is for sale on it. I started my own podcast in 2008, and it lives here too. If a clip or a video brought you to this page, it did the same job yours will do for you. So you are looking at the product right now, and you can judge it for yourself before you ever speak to us.

text.label: Text: Why agency is the word.
text.value: Why agency is the word.

text.label: Text: I use the word agency on purpose. A talent agency only does
text.value: I use the word agency on purpose. A talent agency only does well when its talent does well. That keeps us on the same side of the table as you. Your name is on the cover, your voice is on the show and your face is on the screen. Our work is everything behind it, and we are proud to stay behind it.

text.label: Pull line
text.value: A talent agency only does well when its talent does well.

text.label: Text: Why We Exist
text.value: Why We Exist

text.label: Text: The idea is as old as business. What is new is what it costs
text.value: The idea is as old as business. What is new is what it costs.

text.label: Text: The oldest model there is.
text.value: The oldest model there is.

text.label: Text: Get people's attention. Have something to sell them. Stay in
text.value: Get people's attention. Have something to sell them. Stay in front of them until they are ready to buy. That is how every business that ever ran an advertisement has worked, and I watched it work in every business I owned. Not one piece my team and I use is a new idea. That is good news for you, because a model this old has been proven over and over. What is ours is the way the pieces are joined, and I will show you that further down.

text.label: Text: What it used to cost.
text.value: What it used to cost.

text.label: Text: When I opened that restaurant in 1986, attention was somethi
text.value: When I opened that restaurant in 1986, attention was something you bought. You paid the newspaper, the radio station or the TV station, and somebody there decided whether you got on at all. If you wanted a book in a store, a publisher had to say yes. If you wanted a show, a station had to give you the hour. And once the phone started ringing, you needed people on a payroll to answer it and follow up.

text.label: Text: The doors are open.
text.value: The doors are open.

text.label: Text: Every one of those doors is open today. The social platforms
text.value: Every one of those doors is open today. The social platforms let you stand in front of thousands of people and charge you nothing for it. A podcast costs next to nothing once the technical work is handled. You can publish your own book, with your own name on the cover, and sell it from your own website. Nobody is left to tell you no. The people who used to decide who got heard have lost that job.

text.label: Text: The payroll changed too.
text.value: The payroll changed too.

text.label: Text: The stage was only ever half of it. The other half was peopl
text.value: The stage was only ever half of it. The other half was people. Somebody had to answer every question, get back to everyone who showed interest, ask happy customers to say so, and go back through the old names. That took a staff, and a staff took money most experts never had. AI employees do that work now. They do it at any hour, and they do it the same way every time.

text.label: Text: Never this cheap.
text.value: Never this cheap.

text.label: Text: Put those two changes side by side. The stages cost nothing,
text.value: Put those two changes side by side. The stages cost nothing, and the staff no longer has to be a payroll. We have never had a time in history where you had access to so much of it at such a low price. A coach, an author or an influencer with a small team now stands on the same stages that used to belong to companies with an advertising budget.

text.label: Text: So why us.
text.value: So why us.

text.label: Text: Because cheap tools in a pile are not a business. Almost eve
text.value: Because cheap tools in a pile are not a business. Almost everybody has a few of these pieces. Hardly anybody has them connected, in the right order, pointing at something a person can buy. The pieces are old. The way my team and I connect them is our own, and we call it the Revenue Engine. That is why we exist. We take the stages that cost nothing, the website, the show and the book that you own, and the AI employees that do the follow-up, and we build them into one working thing with your name on it.

text.label: Pull line
text.value: We have never had a time in history where you had access to so much of it at such a low price.

text.label: Text: If You Are The Expert
text.value: If You Are The Expert

text.label: Heading: If you are truly an expert, there should be no reason you ar
text.value: If you are truly an expert, there should be no reason you are not making a lot of money.

text.label: Text: I mean that.
text.value: I mean that.

text.label: Text: I mean that line exactly the way it reads, and I mean it as
text.value: I mean that line exactly the way it reads, and I mean it as good news. If you are truly an expert in your space, with everything that is available today, there should be no reason you are not making a lot of money. The stages are free. The tools are cheap. The people who need your help are on their phones every day looking for somebody like you. So if the money is not showing up, do not read that as a verdict on you. Something is not joined up, and joining things up is a job that can be done.

text.label: Text: The real reason.
text.value: The real reason.

text.label: Text: It is almost never your talent. The reason is that you are n
text.value: It is almost never your talent. The reason is that you are not connecting all the dots properly, and you are not letting the world know you are here to help them with your talent. You show up on one platform and it leads nowhere. You have a website nobody is sent to. You know enough to fill a book and none of it is written down for sale. Each dot is there. Nothing joins them.

text.label: Text: Self-promotion is not bragging.
text.value: Self-promotion is not bragging.

text.label: Text: A lot of very good people are uncomfortable with self-promot
text.value: A lot of very good people are uncomfortable with self-promotion. They think the work should speak for itself. I understand that, and I disagree with it. Nobody can hire a person they have never heard of. The people you could help are out there right now, buying from whoever they happened to hear about first. Letting them know you exist is part of helping them. A talent agent's first job is to get you comfortable with that, and then to do the heavy lifting for you.

text.label: Text: The reps are yours.
text.value: The reps are yours.

text.label: Text: Here is the one thing my team and I cannot build. If you are
text.value: Here is the one thing my team and I cannot build. If you are a coach, an author or an influencer, you have to be the best at what you do. Nobody wants to listen to somebody who has not done the work. The ten thousand hours it takes to become an expert, the years, the clients, the mistakes you learned from, those are the reps. You have to put in the reps. That knowledge is the product, and it only comes from you.

text.label: Text: Everything else is ours.
text.value: Everything else is ours.

text.label: Text: If you have put in the reps, you already hold the part that
text.value: If you have put in the reps, you already hold the part that takes the longest and that money cannot buy. What is left is building, and building is what we do. The website, the book, the podcast, the videos and clips, the answering and the following up can all be built for you by people who do it every day. Expertise takes years to earn. The rest is a matter of putting the right pieces in the right order.

text.label: Text: If you are still early.
text.value: If you are still early.

text.label: Text: Maybe you are still putting in your reps. That is a good pla
text.value: Maybe you are still putting in your reps. That is a good place to be, and it is where every expert started. Keep going. Keep showing up, keep helping people and keep getting better at the thing you do. The stages will still be there when you are ready, and so will we. When you can say in a sentence who you help and what you help them do, you have something worth building around. If you are not sure which side of that line you are on, apply anyway. There are no wrong answers, only a fit today or a fit later.

text.label: Pull line
text.value: If you have put in the reps, you already hold the part that takes the longest and that money cannot buy.

text.label: Heading: Connecting the dots: one person, from the first time they se
text.value: Connecting the dots: one person, from the first time they see you to the day they pay you.

text.label: Text: A stranger with a phone.
text.value: A stranger with a phone.

text.label: Text: Picture one person who has never heard of you. They are scro
text.value: Picture one person who has never heard of you. They are scrolling on a free platform and one of your clips comes up. It is a short piece of something you recorded once, talking about what you know. They stop and watch. It cost you nothing to reach them, and it cost them nothing to listen. That is the first dot, which is attention. For most people with a following, the story ends right here. The person smiles, keeps scrolling and is gone.

text.label: Text: They land on your website.
text.value: They land on your website.

text.label: Text: For you it keeps going, because that clip tells them where t
text.value: For you it keeps going, because that clip tells them where to go next. They tap through and arrive on your website, the one place online that is all about you. In a short visit they can see who you are, who you help and what you sell. They are no longer one face in a crowd on somebody else's platform. They are a guest in your house, and you decide what they see next.

text.label: Text: They listen to you.
text.value: They listen to you.

text.label: Text: Your podcast is sitting right there on the website, so they
text.value: Your podcast is sitting right there on the website, so they play an episode. Now they have a lot more of you than a few seconds. They hear how you think, how you talk and the stories behind what you teach. A clip earns a moment of interest. An episode earns the beginning of trust. You recorded it once, and it does that same job for every stranger who arrives after this one.

text.label: Text: They buy your book.
text.value: They buy your book.

text.label: Text: Next to the podcast is your own e-book, with your name on th
text.value: Next to the podcast is your own e-book, with your name on the cover, for sale. This person is not ready for your program yet, but a book is a small and easy yes. They buy it. That one purchase changes who they are to you. A moment ago they were a follower. Now they are a customer who has paid you, is reading what you know and has given you a way to reach them again.

text.label: Text: They hear from you again.
text.value: They hear from you again.

text.label: Text: Most people need to see you and hear from you seven to ten t
text.value: Most people need to see you and hear from you seven to ten times before they pay for the bigger thing. So the Revenue Engine stays with them. Their questions get answered in seconds. They see what the people you have helped say about you. A new episode reaches them that fits what they asked about. Nobody on your side has to remember this person. The systems do, and they keep you in front of them at a steady pace.

text.label: Text: They pay you.
text.value: They pay you.

text.label: Text: One day the timing is right. They go back to your website an
text.value: One day the timing is right. They go back to your website and book a call, or they buy your program right on the page. By then they have watched you, listened to you and read you. The call is short on convincing and long on details, because the convincing was finished before you ever picked up. Those are the only calls I want on your calendar.

text.label: Text: Count the dots.
text.value: Count the dots.

text.value: Automated Five Star Reviews.

With it, the proof builds month after month. What it hands on is trust, and trust makes every other system work better.

text.label: Text: CRM Mastery.
